description: Feature ledger for AsliJob — a job-offer scam checker for Indian job seekers. State machine: not_started -> active -> blocked | passing. Only one active at a time. passing is irreversible. Owned by the feature-tracker skill; see .agents/skills/feature-tracker/SKILL.md.

features.behavior: Check anything: one input accepts pasted text, a screenshot, a PDF, a phone number, UPI ID, email, link or company name, and every channel routes through POST /api/check which extracts structured fields
Verdict with reasons: the checker returns Safe / Suspicious / Scam with 2-4 plain-language reasons; a fee-to-get-hired always forces at least Suspicious (rules + score)
Scam network check: a looked-up phone/UPI/domain/wallet is flagged when it connects to confirmed scams within two hops in the fraud graph, with a Postgres fallback when the graph is down
Report a scam and 1930 complaint: a two-tap report adds its identifiers to the graph and returns a ready 1930 complaint draft with Copy and Call 1930 actions
Share warning card: one tap generates a verdict image with the main reason and a result link, ready to post into the WhatsApp group the scam came from
Verified offer letter (demo): scanning a letter QR returns 'Verified by the company' or 'Not issued by this company', checked against a daily EAS Merkle-root attestation on Base Sepolia
Telegram bot: forwarding a suspicious message to the bot replies with the same verdict, reasons and share link via the shared check API
Indian languages and voice: the verdict and reasons render in English, Hindi and Marathi, and a question can be asked and answered by voice
College dashboard: a placement officer sees scams reported by their students and the gangs targeting the college, and can warn the whole batch (paid plan)
Employer portal: a company proves its domain, lists real recruiters, issues verified offer letters and gets brand-impersonation alerts
WhatsApp bot: the same check runs inside WhatsApp via the WhatsApp Cloud API webhook
Chrome extension: a 'Check this' button on LinkedIn messages, Naukri listings and Gmail runs the shared check only when the user clicks
Crypto payment check and public API: a USDT address linked to scams triggers a warning, and job portals/banks can query the hashed scam signals through a paid API
Paid subscription billing and webhook gateway: processes Dodo Payments / Razorpay webhooks, verifies HMAC signatures, and activates Campus Shield Pro and Enterprise Guard plans
National Cybercrime 1930 / I4C complaint dossier: generates compliant law enforcement FIR dossiers with transaction trails and evidence hashes for cybercell reporting
Syndicate clustering and mule detection: clusters fraud graph nodes into organized cybercrime rings with Syndicate Threat Index (STI) and cross-state spread

Daily Merkle root batch cron and EIP-712 gasless offer letter attestation: batches registered letters into daily Merkle roots with gasless meta-transaction signing and zero-knowledge candidate privacy proofs
ATS and job board verification connectors: processes Greenhouse and Lever offer webhooks to auto-issue tamper-proof verification QR codes and renders authentic employer job board seals
Automated bank account freeze and mule alert dispatcher: evaluates high-loss mule accounts and generates structured CFCFRMS / NPCI freeze advisories for partner bank fraud desks
